description: NaGdLaSbO₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic F̅43m space group. Na is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent GdO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent SbO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.97 Å. Gd is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form GdO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Gd-O bond lengths are 2.21 Å. La is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent GdO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent SbO₆ octahedra. All La-O bond lengths are 2.97 Å. Sb is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form SbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent GdO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Sb-O bond lengths are 1.98 Å. O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Na, one Gd, two equivalent La, and one Sb atom.
